enchantment.my_enchant_added.simple_prot: Reduces incoming damage by a flat 0.01 per level (stacks across armor) after all other reductions.
enchantment.my_enchant_added.armor.desc: Increases armor by 0.4 per level when equipped.
enchantment.my_enchant_added.hardness.de: Increases armor toughness by 0.3 per level when equipped.
enchantment.my_enchant_added.haste.desc: Increases movement speed by 7.5% per level when worn on boots.
enchantment.my_enchant_added.ratio_sharp: Increases the weapon's attack damage modifier by 4% per level (base unarmed damage of 1 is not scaled).
enchantment.my_enchant_added.rock.desc: Right-click in inventory to lock or unlock the item, preventing drops, movement, and forced drops.
enchantment.my_enchant_added.automatic_r: Repairs 0.01% of maximum durability every tick.
